title: Extremal product laws

premises.scope: Completed D_k decoupling/Jensen formula, fractional-potential Fourier lemma, and scalar square peel.
Latest completed designated partner: at most four physical hubs and complementary diagonal + symmetric rank<=2 + zero-diagonal Frobenius residual O(rho^-3/2).
No-attainment L1 finite-mixture/product-indicator purification; no support diameter or fragment-count claim.
Independent scalar square-bank convolution converts an H_{1/2} bound on a disjoint bank into a density bound; used only for the genuinely independent subbranch.

designated_partner.actual_use: The r33 symmetric-rank-two O(rho^-3/2) normal form is inserted into the new robust pair-volume theorem, yielding a full-form H_{1/2} bound in its diffuse nondegenerate carrier branch without deleting the residual.

results.statement: For physical M=A[I,J], natural squared-2-minor row marginals <=h<1 imply H_{1/2}(Q)<=C2(h)e2(M^TM)^(-1/8), with C2=8e^(1/4) for h<=1/2 and 4e^(1/4)(2h)^(-1/4)/(1-h) for h>1/2. Arbitrary self blocks, outside couplings and affine terms are retained.

For scalar pivot d and anchored Schur pair-volume W3_i, T=rho|d|^(1/4)W3_i^(1/8)>=16e^(1/4) forces one physical row and one physical column to carry joint anchored volume mass >1-16e^(1/4)/T; otherwise W3_i<(16e^(1/4)/rho)^8|d|^-2.

If A[K,K]=D+U Lambda U^T+E, min|lambda|>=sigma, max row leverage<=1/32, and ||E||F<=3sigma/64, then H_{1/2}(Q)<=64e^(1/4)/sqrt(21sigma)<17.933 sigma^-1/2 for the full ambient form. E is kept inside the actual physical cross block.
In partner r33's rho>=12sqrt(pi) survivor, if rank R=2, min carrier eigenvalue modulus >=sigma and max range leverage<=1/32, then rho>=589.851 sigma^(-2/3) implies H_{1/2}(Q)<17.933 sigma^-1/2.

next_step: Use the diffuse rank-two rough-tail H_{1/2} receiver together with a mixed Fresnel/decoupling or rank-one-Schur exterior identity to pay a third spectral direction that shares original inputs or is bilinearly hub-coupled; separately compile localized/rank-one/no-scalar-pivot survivors. Preserve the actual E block.
